title: Ambient
tagline: Music that makes space, texture, and attention part of the composition.
summary: Ambient music foregrounds atmosphere and texture, often using sustained tones, gradual change, and open-ended forms. It can sit in the background or reward close listening, depending on how its layers unfold. The style draws on electronic studios, experimental composition, field recordings, and acoustic instruments, with artists continually redefining what a musical environment can be.

pillars.name: Brian Eno
pillars.why: Brian Eno helped define ambient as music designed to shape an environment while remaining open to focused listening.

pillars.name: Tangerine Dream
pillars.why: Tangerine Dream developed expansive electronic sequences that became a key influence on ambient and soundtrack music.

pillars.name: Pauline Oliveros
pillars.why: Pauline Oliveros connected experimental sound with deep listening and a distinctive, participatory approach to music.
